layers.source_basis: Retain each native client for its existing account, model controls and session lifecycle. Codex documents noninteractive execution and resume; Claude documents headless structured results and native workflows. This is an interface-fit preference, not evidence one model produces better changes.
layers.overturn_test: Run identical bounded edit and read-only research tasks with the accepted native sign-ins; interrupt, resume and inspect exit status, full result, diff and provider usage. Switch a workload only if a challenger completes the same acceptance checks with a material quality, control or cost advantage.

layers.source_basis: Use native subagents and Claude workflows first, with an explicit result contract, owned worktrees and coordinator integration. Current docs expose concurrency, tool/model controls, pause/cancel and saved workflows without replacing native accounts.
layers.overturn_test: Use three workers: successful edit, deliberate failure and long-running child process. Cancel and restart the coordinator; require one explicit terminal record per worker, stopped descendants, surviving artifacts and conflict-free reviewed integration. Add a SDK/graph only if native behavior fails a required property.

layers.source_basis: Combine each native client's enforced sandbox with Git worktrees for edit ownership. On Linux/WSL2, Claude's documented sandbox uses bubblewrap and network controls; worktrees separate checkout state but provide no filesystem or network security boundary.
layers.overturn_test: Within disposable fixtures, attempt prohibited read/write, outbound requests and descendant escape; cancel the task and verify termination. Test worktree cross-write denial separately. Choose containers when they demonstrably enforce a required restriction the native policy cannot.

layers.source_basis: Use native agents for bounded research, systemd for local lifecycle and Prefect only where an explicit research DAG warrants it. Require complete terminal results, artifact manifests and failures, with telemetry linked to the run.
layers.overturn_test: Run bounded research fixtures with success, timeout, invalid data and worker cancellation. Require terminal records for every requested unit, recoverable source artifacts and denied access to broker secrets/endpoints. Crash and resume without duplicating outputs; add a graph/server only for measured missing guarantees.

Require no surviving descendants, explicit failures and no duplicated committed effect. Move to Prefect or Temporal only if required retries/history/distribution exceed the accepted local design.

layers.source_basis: LangGraph helps application-level checkpointed reasoning; Temporal helps distributed long-lived operational recovery. Their strongest case is a concrete state/retry requirement that native sessions and bounded research tasks cannot meet.
layers.overturn_test: Run bounded research fixtures with success, timeout, invalid data and worker cancellation. Require terminal records for every requested unit, recoverable source artifacts and denied access to broker secrets/endpoints. Crash and resume without duplicating outputs; add a graph/server only for measured missing guarantees.

layers.source_basis: Compose attributable filings, preserved document structure, scoped text retrieval, exact source navigation and structured as-of queries. Financial facts need deterministic dates and identities alongside prose; a semantic memory store cannot supply causality by itself.
layers.overturn_test: At historical cutoffs, ask questions whose later filings change the answer. Require only then-available sources, original accession/page/row recovery and deterministic structured values; add cross-project canaries and deleted records. Prefer a consolidated service only if it improves recall without temporal or scope leakage.

layers.source_basis: Databento is a defensible candidate for explicitly identified US-equity market observations and point-in-time reference/corporate-action handling; EdgarTools supplies attributable filings. DuckDB and Polars provide local reproducible transformations over retained raw data.
layers.overturn_test: Compare identical instruments/dates, including delistings, splits, dividends, symbol changes, late corrections and halts. Rebuild an as-of eligible universe, reconcile unadjusted/adjusted prices and costs, and measure missing/duplicate records plus actual license and retrieval expense. Choose by required coverage and verified causality.

layers.overturn_test: Run the same causal data and deterministic risk/accounting fixture in each engine, reconcile cash/positions/fees/splits/dividends against an independent ledger, then separately qualify IBKR paper and Alpaca paper. Include stale data, rejected/partial/duplicate fills, disconnect-before-ack, restart and reconciliation. Prefer Nautilus if its required adapter path and recovery outperform while both broker gates pass.
